blacklist.name: Graham International University
blacklist.reason: Not authorized to operate or award degrees by the Pennsylvania Department of Education (confirmed in writing, Nov 2025); falsely claims CHEA recognition (CHEA verified no such recognition exists); not authorized by the California Bureau for Private Postsecondary Education.

blacklist.name: Saint Regis University
blacklist.reason: Operators indicted October 2005 (E.D. Washington); principals pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit mail and wire fraud (2006). DOJ-estimated ~10,800 degrees sold to ~9,600 buyers in 131 countries.

blacklist.name: LaSalle University (Louisiana)
blacklist.reason: Owner James Kirk imprisoned; targeted by the FBI's DipScam task force. U.S. GAO documented federal employees holding bogus LaSalle degrees (one paid $5,000 for a master's with no classes or tests). Not the accredited La Salle University in Philadelphia.

blacklist.name: Columbia State University
blacklist.reason: Operator Ronald Pellar pleaded guilty to nine felony counts of mail fraud (U.S. District Court, Santa Ana, January 2004) for running a diploma mill from a Metairie, Louisiana mailbox.

blacklist.name: Belford University
blacklist.reason: Online degree mill shut down by court order.

blacklist.name: Pacific Western University
blacklist.reason: Historically flagged as a degree mill in multiple jurisdictions.
